nginx: the configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf syntax is ok
nginx: configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf test is successful
# configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf:
user www-data;
worker_processes auto;
events { worker_connections 768; }
http {
    include /etc/nginx/conf.d/*.conf;
    include /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/*;
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/museum.org:
server {
    listen 80;
    listen [::]:80;
    server_name museum.org www.museum.org;
    return 301 https://$host$request_uri;
}
server {
    listen 443 ssl;
    listen [::]:443 ssl;
    http2 on;
    server_name museum.org www.museum.org;
    root /home/museum.org/httpdocs;
    error_log /var/log/nginx/museum.org/error.log;
    access_log /var/log/nginx/museum.org/access.log;
    ssl_certificate /etc/letsencrypt/live/museum.org/fullchain.pem;
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/museum.org/privkey.pem;
    location ~ \.php$ {
        fastcgi_pass unix:/run/php/php8.2-fpm.sock;
    }
}
